case_file.summary: A senior financial auditor was found dead late at night inside a locked archive room at his firm. The building showed no signs of forced entry, and security systems appeared intact. The victim was known for investigating high-profile corruption cases involving missing funds and falsified records. Several colleagues had motives to silence him, and crucial documents vanished shortly before his death. What initially appeared to be a sudden collapse quickly unfolded into a calculated murder hidden beneath layers of deception.

evidences.title: Autopsy Report
evidences.content: The autopsy confirmed that the victim died from acute poisoning caused by a tasteless chemical compound mixed into a beverage. The poison acts slowly, causing death hours after ingestion, making the time of poisoning difficult to trace.

evidences.title: Security Camera Logs
evidences.content: Security footage shows a five-minute blackout on the archive floor due to a manual power interruption. During this window, camera feeds were disabled. Only one staff member had access to the electrical control room.

evidences.title: Missing Ledger
evidences.content: A critical financial ledger documenting illegal transfers was removed from the archive. Backup copies were wiped from the system using administrator credentials.

evidences.title: Coffee Mug Analysis
evidences.content: Chemical residue matching the poison was found in the victim’s coffee mug. Fingerprints belonged to the victim and one other individual who claimed never to enter the archive room.

evidences.title: Access Card Records
evidences.content: Electronic access logs reveal that one suspect entered the archive floor after official working hours, despite claiming to have left the building earlier.

suspects.name: Mona Adel
suspects.description: The victim’s assistant. Recently questioned for altering audit schedules and hiding files.

suspects.name: Khalid Hassan
suspects.description: Head of IT security. Had administrator access to both camera systems and digital records.

suspects.name: Yasir Mahmoud
suspects.description: Senior accountant under investigation by the victim for financial misconduct.

suspects.name: Nabil Farouk
suspects.description: Facility manager responsible for electrical systems and building access.

questions.question: What was the actual cause of the victim’s death?
Which evidence proves the crime was premeditated?
Which action directly helped conceal the crime?
Who had both physical access and system-level control?
